item.title: Shared Task at SIGTURK 2027 Workshop
item.description: Culture and Understanding Across Turkic Languages The SIGTURK 2027 shared task evaluates cultural and linguistic understanding in five Turkic languages written in three scripts. It has two tracks, Text / LLM and Vision / VLM. Teams may enter either track or both. Language Code Turkish tr-Latn Azerbaijani az-Latn Uzbek uz-Latn Kazakh
